maintenance_led.reason: Revenue mainly from aerial firefighting and air attack services flown for agencies; in-house MRO supports its own fleet.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are federal, state, provincial and local wildfire agencies (USFS, DOI, State of Alaska) paying for aerial firefighting.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grew by adding Super Scoopers and aircraft to its own fleet and contracts, not a steady stream of company acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Safety-critical wildfire suppression with FAA-certified, agency-approved aircraft; scarce Super Scoopers and IGNIS integration make switching hard.
